events.title: BTC pushed above $80,000 in the last 24 hours (high $81,971) and pulled back

messages.text:
**Daily Market Summary · 30 October 2026**

**Alert**
• BTC pushed above $80,000 in the last 24 hours (high $81,971) and pulled back. It slipped to about $78,000 within hours as news of a hack at Binance broke, so the $80,000 level has not held.

**Snapshot**
• Bitcoin about $78,028, down about 3.9% over 7 days.
• Headline: BULLISH, medium confidence (the long-run uptrend still holds).
• Fear & Greed 30 (fear), and bets on further falls are unusually popular.

**What happened (last 24h)**
• Binance estimates about $6.3 billion was taken from its hot wallets and has paused deposits and withdrawals. It says about $3 billion is frozen and it will cover all losses (PANews).
• About $629 million of bets were forced to close in one hour as the news broke, almost all of them bets on a rise; the 24-hour total was about $953 million (CoinGlass via PANews).

**Short-term outlook (next 1-7 days)**
Soft and leaning down: price has been under its 50-day average for nine days, about 5% below it.
• Turns up: a close above $79,750, then $81,931 (the 50-day average).
• Sideways: $76,250-$79,750; a normal week swings about $3,350.
• Turns down: a close below $76,250, then $73,125 (the 200-day average).
• Rally watch: quiet. A rally window opens above $87,685 and a drop signal starts below $74,694.
• This week: Binance reopening withdrawals and its promised post-mortem, then the US midterm elections on 3 November. Next Fed meeting: 8 December.

**News that matters**
• Binance hack, about $6.3 billion (PANews): short term, large negative.
• ECB officials reportedly expect a rate rise on 17 December (PANews): medium term, small negative.
• Nasdaq pushing listed companies against trading their shares on OKX-ICE (PANews): medium term, small negative.

**Altcoins & themes**
• Tokens the attacker sold fell (ENA -5.5%, AAVE -4.6%, STRK -6.8%), while HYPE rose about 18% with no single cause reported.

**Bigger picture**
• The next month is mixed (up 24% over 90 days, but down about 7% over 30); the 3-6 month trend still leans up while price holds above $73,125.

https://andrifa.github.io/crypto-market-state-dashboard/

**Digital marketing / Paid:** Keep acquisition growing in small weekly steps toward active traders, in line with SCALE UP, but swap price-move hooks for trust-led creatives (security, licensing, how it works) while the Binance hack news is fresh. Speed up only once price wins back $81,931, and keep part of the increase ready to pause if price closes below $74,694, where a drop signal would start.

**Social media & content:** Keep the normal posting rhythm and shift topics to trust and plain explanations. Post a calm, facts-only explainer on the Binance hack (about $6.3 billion taken, about $3 billion frozen, losses to be covered, per PANews) with no dig at a competitor, a 'how exchanges protect funds' post, and one daily recap covering the slide to about $78,000 and the $79,750 / $76,250 levels.

**CRM:** No promotional pressure this week. Send active users a calm account-safety reminder (2FA, withdrawal whitelists, phishing) and say Reku is unaffected by the Binance incident only if the security team confirms it. Keep onboarding education running without time-limited offers, and keep the rally-window journey ready to trigger on a close above $87,685.
